sourceText: User approved implementing a follow-up after B-7ba7: when all milestones are complete, print a final closeout table showing every milestone status, what problem it solved, and what evidence shows, instead of relying only on live milestone_status after DONE drift.
normalizedOutcome: A DONE story has a stable closeout snapshot and a read-only command that prints every final milestone with status, solved problem, acceptance rule, evidence, risks, and next action.
acceptanceClaim: The CLI can generate and read a DONE milestone closeout snapshot without changing live milestone_status freshness semantics.
